video.description: CLOVER prop-free (refs/characters/clover_noprop_ref.png): both paws empty, no carrot in her pocket. In the garden beside one potted sunflower drooping low, its head hanging; the blue watering can with the white daisy on the ground beside her from the first frame.

beats.action: Clover notices the drooping sunflower, says the line, tilts her head with ears up.
She looks at camera and says the line, then reaches down to the watering can.
Silent: she pours water onto the pot; the sunflower slowly lifts its head up tall.
She sets the can down, turns to camera, delighted, says the line.

notes: Pacing standard: 11 words + sign-off, gaps >= 0.7s, the silent pour is the lesson beat and never shortens. Franchise: Clover Grows It.
